build_noise_sampler: build a uniform or normal noise sampler with a given epsilon value for R3F regularization
compute_symmetric_kl: compute the symmetric KL divergence between noised logits and input logits for R3F loss
create_r3f_config: create an R3FConfigOptions instance with custom lambda, epsilon, and noise type settings
use_r3f_noise_context_manager: use the R3FNoiseContextManager to inject noise into an embedding module via a forward hook
train_batch_with_r3f: train a model batch using the R3FPyTextMixin train_batch method with R3F regularization loss
